name: fooyin
description:
fooyin is a music player built around customisation. Arrange its interface from a blank
canvas, start with a preset layout, and tailor its widgets and shortcuts to suit you.

Browse and filter your library, edit tags and artwork, and organise tracks in playlists
or autoplaylists. Enjoy gapless playback of local music, archives, and remote radio, with
ReplayGain, audio conversion, fading, and DSP chains for shaping the sound.

Extend the player with plugins for audio formats, widgets, visualisations, lyrics,
scrobbling, and other integrations. FooScript provides advanced display formatting,
library queries, autoplaylists, and custom widget behaviour.
